title: Portfolio Recommendation
description: Proposed target-weight changes for a portfolio. Context for `demo.CreateOrderProposal` (Order Entry turns this into a signed `demo.orderProposal`).

portfolioId.title: Portfolio ID
portfolioId.description: Id of the portfolio these target changes apply to.

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: Why these target changes are recommended.

targetChanges.title: Target changes
targetChanges.description: Per-ticker target weight (0–1 of portfolio MV) and action.

targetWeight.title: Target weight
targetWeight.description: Target weight as a fraction of portfolio market value (0–1).

evidenceRefs.title: Evidence refs
evidenceRefs.description: Optional ids of research/risk evidence used for the recommendation.
